score_evidence.A: Jailbreak H2 is heading-only: L131 '## 탈옥은 안전 학습의 구조적 실패이고...' is followed directly by another H2 at L133. Truncated sections: L205 MCP subsection ends with the single word '첫째'; L382 ends mid-sentence '에이전트'. L438-439 orphan paragraph starts '대신 공격 위치가 바뀌면 보장이 사라집니다.' with no antecedent (a paragraph was dropped). The RAG section (L133-160) covers only PoisonedRAG's objective, with no results; AgentPoison has only a figure (L137-141); BadAgent, RAGForensics and ETDI have no sections. The comparison table (L441-459) comes after the two subsections that interpret it (L416-437). L414 promises columns '위협 모델, 주요 수치, 한계', but the table has 논문/계보/주요 결과/한계. L104 uses a bare '|' as the conditional inside $$ (rubric requires \mid). Front matter is otherwise valid (use_math true, two-level categories, 138-char description).
score_evidence.B: Heading register is mixed: da-form at L11 '받아들일 수 있다', L48 '진화했다', L52 '쟀다', L89 '뚫었다', L97 '무너졌다', L133 '고를 수 있다', L143 '설득해야 한다', L162 '되었다', L261 '옮겨갔다', against 입니다-form at L207, L265, L279, L346. Pipeline meta-text leaks into the prose: L289 '논문은 이 수치가 상대 개선인지 %p인지 이 서술에서 구분하지 않습니다' (twice), L305 '어떤 공격이 가장 강했는지와 평가 벤치마크는 이 비교 서술에 따로 적혀 있지 않습니다', L303 '이 글이 인용하는 비교 서술에는 ... 적혀 있지 않습니다', L336 '논문이 이 서술에서 함께 밝히지 않습니다'. The formula '이 글의 관점에서 (보면|정리하면)' recurs (L68, L70, L95, L129, L199, L259, L309, L342). Terms are inconsistent: '하름 점수' (L422, L455) vs '유해 점수' (L247). L439 has a double '대신'. Table cells are English: L443 '35 base prompts, success rate', L445 'curated and synthetic prompt datasets; attack success', L447 '250-fold 효율 (PAIR vs GCG, query count)'.
score_evidence.C: Several back-references point at things never introduced. L195 '앞서 본 PAIR의 반복 개선 루프': PAIR is never explained because the jailbreak section is empty. L277 '앞서 다룬 Llama와 Mistral 기반 모델', L289 '앞서 다룬 OpenAI의 GPT Turbo 모델', L305 '앞서 본 Mistral과 Llama3의 Instruct 모델' and L334 '앞서 다룬 Claude Sonnet 모델' all refer to models not discussed before. L346-372 builds a cross-lineage argument on GCG/PAIR/TAP/SmoothLLM, which have no sections of their own (SmoothLLM first appears at L362). Facts are repeated: the AgentDojo tool-filter failure condition appears three times (L239, L334, L396); CaMeL's core claim appears at L313, L487 and L506.
score_evidence.D: Good: the personal-assistant running example is used throughout; formulas are unpacked symbol by symbol (L107, L152-158, L301); hypothetical worked examples are labelled (L66, L275, L323-332). Weak: the hard jailbreak mechanisms (GCG, PAIR) get no explanation at all (L131 is empty), and the hedging meta-text (L289, L303, L305, L336) adds noise rather than help.
score_evidence.E: Eleven source figures with descriptive captions, plus formulas, two code/tables. The comparison table cites the paper's own numbering: L453 '(Fig. 4, 3개 에이전트 평균)', L456 '(... Table 2)'. It omits rows for HouYi, SmoothLLM, BadAgent, SecAlign, AiTM, RAGForensics and ETDI. Several cells are English or prose (L443, L445, L452 '도구 필터의 한계', L444 '정량 수치 없음').
score_evidence.F: Two of 15 checked claims are wrong (ToolHijacker detector FNR '>90%', PoisonedRAG k=50 scope), plus an unscoped field-wide gap claim (L495) and a generalisation at L463 ('최근 연구는 ... 무게를 옮기고 있습니다'). Most numbers match the sources cell for cell.
score_evidence.S1: Limitation cells that are findings or defense results: ToolHijacker L459 'known-answer/DataSentinel FNR >90%'; Prompt Infection L454 'Marking 76% 허용'. English unit words in cells (L443-459). Explanations repeated across sections (tool filter, CaMeL, AgentHarm capability retention L253/L422/L475).

claim_headings.evidence: Most H2/H3 headings are claims (L48, L97, L261, L461), but L131 is a claim heading with no body, and register varies between da-form and 입니다-form.

running_example.evidence: The personal-assistant agent is set up at L15 and used in every lineage (L83, L107, L181, L219, L275, L323-332, L501).

mechanism_design_formula_example.evidence: Done for Adaptive IPI (L101-115), SecAlign (L297-303) and CaMeL (L315-332). Jailbreaks are absent (L131). PoisonedRAG stops after the conditions (L160) with no results. MCP is truncated (L205).

facts_said_once.evidence: Tool-filter failure at L239, L334, L396. CaMeL control/data-flow claim at L313, L487, L506. Greshake threat-model widening at L17 (twice in one paragraph), L74. ToolHijacker vs SecAlign at L402, L431, L505. Instruction-hierarchy limits at L291, L428. AgentHarm capability retention at L253, L422, L475.

numbers_scoped.evidence: Most numbers carry model and setting (L68, L223, L247). The PoisonedRAG k=50 cell (L449) drops that it is the ASR under the knowledge-expansion defense. L289 says 'GPT Turbo' where the paper has GPT-3.5 Turbo. Meta disclaimers stand in for scope (L289, L336).

nothing_invented.evidence: Hypothetical examples are labelled ('가상의 예', L275, L323, L358), but L404 says 'FNR이 90%를 넘어' while DataSentinel's gradient-based FNR is exactly 90%, and L495 makes a field-wide gap claim.

writers_assessment_at_end.evidence: L489, L503-509 give the writer's judgement: adaptive attacks as default, permissions and data flow over model judgement, utility and security measured together. The open gaps are stated as the writer's view.

length_fitted.evidence: 541 lines (~120KB). Benchmarks and defenses run long (L207-344) and the synthesis sections repeat them (L384-509), while the jailbreak, poisoning and MCP lineages are empty or truncated.

type_specific_shape.evidence: Survey numbers are not owned by one table: the body restates them all (58.6% at L68 and L443; 24%/47% at L223 and L450; 77%/84% at L336 and L457; 6.6%/7.1% at L223 and L450). The table sits after its own interpretation (L416-437 vs L441).

korean_style.evidence: The prose is mostly natural 입니다체, but headings switch register, '이 글의 관점에서' is formulaic and repeated, meta-text leaks (L289, L305, L336), '하름 점수' is a transliteration (L422), and table cells are English.

top_issues: Whole lineages are missing or truncated: the jailbreak H2 (L131) is empty, the MCP subsection stops at '첫째' (L205), the memory/propagation subsection stops at '에이전트' (L382), and the RAG section has no AgentPoison, BadAgent or RAGForensics coverage, so 6 plan papers are never cited in the body.
False back-references to material never introduced: '앞서 본 PAIR' (L195), '앞서 다룬 Llama와 Mistral' (L277), '앞서 다룬 OpenAI의 GPT Turbo' (L289), '앞서 본 Mistral과 Llama3' (L305), '앞서 다룬 Claude Sonnet' (L334).

The comparison table breaks the survey rules: it comes after its own interpretation (L416-437 vs L441), has English unit words in cells, cites 'Fig. 4'/'Table 2', has a ToolHijacker limitation cell that is a finding (checklist repeat), drops scope (PoisonedRAG k=50 is under a defense), misses 7 plan papers (including SecAlign), and the body restates every number.

Facts are repeated across sections (tool filter at L239/L334/L396, CaMeL core at L313/L487/L506, AgentHarm capability at L253/L422/L475), and pipeline meta-text leaks ('이 서술에서 ... 밝히지 않습니다' at L289/L303/L305/L336), inflating length to 541 lines.

Factual and scope slips: ToolHijacker 'FNR이 90%를 넘어' (L404; DataSentinel is 90%), an unscoped field-wide gap claim (L495), the wrong venue 'Findings of ACL' for the NAACL Findings paper (L532), mixed da-form and 입니다-form headings, and '|' instead of \mid in L104.
